title: Plan your usage before you start
scenario: You are about to use AI to draft a quarterly report section. It will include customer examples and figures from three internal dashboards. Your workplace has no explicit AI policy yet — and the section goes out under your name.
task: Write your usage plan before you start: what you will paste, what stays out, what you will verify, and what you will disclose. Then self-check it against the rubric and compare with a model answer.

rubric.label: Says what will actually be pasted — the scrubbed, safe version
Names what stays out: secrets, personal data, confidential figures
Lists verification steps for every figure, name and claim
States how and to whom the AI assistance will be disclosed
Keeps a human checkpoint before anything ships

modelAnswer:
Plan:

1. Paste: the section outline, my own draft paragraphs, and the three dashboards' structure with fake sample values. Customer examples become 'Client A / Client B, typical usage ranges'.

2. Never paste: customer names, emails or contract values; raw dashboard exports; anything marked confidential; unreleased numbers.

3. Verify: every figure checked against its dashboard before it reaches the report; every customer example fictionalized or cleared for use; numbers re-typed by me into the final document, not copy-pasted from a draft.

4. Disclose: since no policy exists, I will note in the document's change log that AI assisted the draft, and flag the missing policy to my manager so we set a team rule.

5. Human checkpoint: I review the full section against the source dashboards line by line before it goes anywhere — the signature stays mine.
hints: Four lines: paste / never / verify / disclose.
What does 'under your name' change about the final step?
explanation: A complete plan answers all four lines and keeps the checkpoint explicit: scrubbed inputs, named exclusions, figure-level verification, honest disclosure of both the assistance and the missing policy. The last line is the one people drop — and the one the signature depends on.
